details: Bitcoin has maintained its position above $86,000, with traders adjusting to expectations that the U.S. Federal Reserve will not raise interest rates in October. This macroeconomic sentiment has fueled market activity and demonstrated price resilience. However, Bitcoin has approached $87,000 twice in the last week but retreated, suggesting some resistance at that level.
title: Bitcoin Holds Above $86K Amid Stable Interest Rate Outlook

details: The queue for Ethereum investors looking to exit staking has reached its longest point in 2026, with the amount of Ether waiting to enter staking having fallen by over 25% since early September. This development indicates a potential shift in investor sentiment regarding staking liquidity and engagement.
title: Ethereum Staking Exit Queue Reaches 2026 Highs

details: Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) have seen a third consecutive week of inflows, attracting significant capital, including $6.34 billion in net inflows during Q3, reversing earlier outflows. In contrast, Ether ETFs experienced $138 million in outflows, indicating a notable shift in investor sentiment and capital allocation between the two leading cryptocurrencies.
title: Divergent ETF Flows: Bitcoin Inflows

details: Executives from three major French crypto-related companies have put forward a proposal to directly tax conversions of cryptocurrencies into stablecoins. This regulatory suggestion, if implemented, could impact liquidity and trading strategies for investors in France and potentially set a precedent for other jurisdictions.
title: French Executives Propose Tax on Crypto-to-Stablecoin Conversions

details: The Independent Community Bankers of America (ICBA) has filed a lawsuit against the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) in federal court. The suit challenges the OCC's framework for crypto trust banks, arguing that the agency exceeded its authority. This legal challenge introduces uncertainty for crypto custodians and other businesses seeking national trust charters.
title: Community Banks Challenge US Crypto Trust Bank Framework
